instagram.caption:
The Turkey Bowl sells out in minutes. Your squares board never does. Swipe for the booster club version.

New Canaan and Darien booster clubs, teams and PTOs: Thanksgiving is less than four weeks away. A free 100 square board for the Turkey Bowl or the NFL games that follow is an easy one to sell to families and alumni. Half the pot goes to the winner, half to your group.

Hosting today? Georgia vs Florida is at 3:30 on ABC. Try a board on it first.
